newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Berisha appoints new Bank of Albania governor.
newsitem.headline: Berisha appoints new Bank of Albania governor.

text.p: President Sali Berisha has signed a decree appointing Qamil Tusha as the new governor of the Bank of Albania, a presidency spokeswoman said on Friday.
"Qamil Tusha has already taken up his duties as the new central bank governor with a seven-year appointment," Linda Ihsani told Reuters.
She said that the supervising board of the Bank of Albania had chosen Tusha as the new governor and that Berisha had signed a decree confirming the appointment.
Central bank sources told Reuters that Tusha was previously deputy director of the National Commercial Bank, a state-run commercial bank.
Press reports said that the previous governor, Kristaq Luniku, was now working with the International Monetary Fund in Washington advising on the Albanian economy.
Albania is rebuilding its economy after an armed insurrection in late February triggered by the collapse of fraudulent savings schemes. More than 300 people have been killed in the violence.
